sources.snippet: For our recent Olmo3 paper, we used the following scripts to train our models. Note: OLMo 3 SFT uses the OLMo-core SFT implementation for better GPU efficiency. DPO and RL training use open-instruct. The build_image_and_launch.sh script only works for open-instruct jobs (DPO, RL), not for SFT.
